title: Ask
description: An ask as the agent sends it to the ask tool (AD-7): its ID, the optional fields, and its items in English only: one or more questions, or one or more areas each holding questions (FR-1, FR-2). A board of one question is the single-question board whatever its presentation and delivery say (EXPERIENCE, Presentations). Further checks the schema cannot express run in the contract's validation function: item IDs unique in the ask, the reserved view-made prefix, areas all or none at the top level, unique option labels, at most one recommended option per question and the room an answer needs.

item.description: A top-level item, picked by its type: a question or an area.
